Instructions for Use
Device description: The Cobalt SCS System is a spinal cord stimulation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Cobalt SCS System has not been evaluated for safety in the MR environment.
It has not been tested for heating or unwanted movement in the MR environment. The safety of the Cobalt SCS System in the MR environment is unknown. Performing an MR exam on a person who has this medical device may result in injury or device malfunction.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
